## The previous part ends

- t: ወአንከርዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነቢያትኑ ፡ ኍሉቅ ፨ ፨
- i: And they all marveled at him and said, 'This is a prophet's son. Is he counted among the prophets?'

Words in this part: 515.
